title: Wide Mouth Mason Jars 16 oz with Lids [6 Pack], Canning Jars with Metal Airtight Lids and Bands, 16 oz Glass Jars for Fermenting, Pickling, Freezing, Preserving, Meal Prep, Jar Décor
description:
About this item
🍊6-PACK MASON JARS: Our canning jars are equipped with metal lids and bands, which is perfect for canning, pickling, preserving and fermenting fruits and veggies. Embossed measurement markings & wide mouth ensure easy and precise filling.
🍊HIGH QUALITY GLASS JARS: Our mason jars 16 oz are made of BPA-free, toxic-free and lead-free glass, which ensures the food-grade quality. Durable clear glass for easy visibility & long time use. Heat-tempered material for microwave (without lids and bands), refrigerator (under the freezing-fill line) and dishwasher safe.
🍊AIRTIGHT & LEAKPROOF SEAL: Each jar's lid is equipped with a silicone liner which ensures the time-tested airtight sealing. Our wide mouth mason jars perform well no matter working as canning jars, pickle jars, pickling jars, jelly jars, or jam jars etc.
🍊VERSATILE WIDE MOUTH JARS: mason jars wide mouth are suitable for storing all kinds of foods, such as pickles, jams, jellies, overnight oats, spices and so on. With embossed decoration fruits on, these glass jars also work as overnight oats containers with lids, DIY projects, home decoration and unique gifts with string and ribbons. Compatible with the ball jars products.
🍊CUSTOMER SATISFACTION GUARANTEE: Our canning jars wide mouth are securely packed in layers of styrofoam and heavy cardboard, to make sure that these canning jars your get are all in best condition. If any glass jars your received are cracked or broken, please feel free to contact us. We will provide a satisfying solution for you.

Watch out! Was making a batch of overnight oats. As soon as I started mixing in the milk it began to leak out of the side of the jar! Discovered a small hole in the glass. Not knowing if I had knocked a weak spot in the glass with my spoon or whether the hole had been there all the time, had to throw out the whole batch. Didn't want to eat glass! Never again will I buy a cheaper brand...you get what you pay for!Click to play video
Do not buy these! The lids and threads do not fit my other wide mouth jars and vice versa. I washed a bunch of my old ones with these new jars and me and my husband had to trial and error all the lids on the jars to find which ones fit. I wasn’t canning at the time but I would have been PISSED to be manhandling all my clean jars and lids to find the right ones.
Buy ORIGINAL ball brand. I found original ball brand jars for cheaper than these!
